raw_responses.Bulgarian:

The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and represents a numerical scale ranging from -1 to 22, with tick marks at integer values. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" and represents a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2.

The third line is green, dashed-dotted, and labeled "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33". It starts at approximately 0.8 when Layer is -1 and decreases to approximately 0.1 when Layer is 22, with fluctuations between Layers 15 and 22.
